constraints.name: ck_application_templates_idempotency_pair
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((idempotency_key_hash IS NULL) AND (idempotency_request_hash IS NULL)) OR ((idempotency_key_hash IS NOT NULL) AND (idempotency_request_hash IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: credential_delivery_records_credential_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (credential_id) REFERENCES issuance_service.issued_credentials(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: credential_delivery_records_transaction_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (transaction_id) REFERENCES issuance_service.issuance_transactions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: evidence_fact_heads_application_id_fkey

constraints.name: evidence_fact_heads_fact_id_fkey

constraints.name: fk_evidence_fact_heads_tenant_application

constraints.name: fk_evidence_fact_heads_tenant_fact
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (organization_id, application_id, logical_key, fact_id) REFERENCES issuance_service.evidence_facts(organization_id, application_id, logical_key, id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: evidence_facts_application_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (application_id) REFERENCES issuance_service.applications(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: fk_evidence_facts_superseded_fact_id

constraints.name: fk_evidence_facts_tenant_application

constraints.name: fk_evidence_facts_tenant_superseded
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (organization_id, application_id, logical_key, superseded_fact_id) REFERENCES issuance_service.evidence_facts(organization_id, application_id, logical_key, id)

constraints.name: ck_evidence_policy_reviews_resolution_claim
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((resolution_claim_token IS NULL) AND (resolution_claim_action IS NULL) AND (resolution_claimed_at IS NULL)) OR (((status)::text = 'open'::text) AND (resolution_claim_token IS NOT NULL) AND ((resolution_claim_action)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['dismiss'::character varying, 'suspend'::character varying, 'revoke'::character varying, 'evidence_recovered'::character varying])::text[])) AND (resolution_claimed_at IS NOT NULL))))
constraints.alternate_definition: CHECK ((((resolution_claim_token IS NULL) AND (resolution_claim_action IS NULL) AND (resolution_claimed_at IS NULL)) OR (((status)::text = 'open'::text) AND (resolution_claim_token IS NOT NULL) AND ((resolution_claim_action)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('dismiss'::character varying)::text, ('suspend'::character varying)::text, ('revoke'::character varying)::text, ('evidence_recovered'::character varying)::text])) AND (resolution_claimed_at IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: ck_evidence_policy_reviews_status
constraints.definition: CHECK (((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['open'::character varying, 'dismissed'::character varying, 'suspended'::character varying, 'revoked'::character varying, 'resolved'::character varying])::text[])))
constraints.alternate_definition: CHECK (((status)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('open'::character varying)::text, ('dismissed'::character varying)::text, ('suspended'::character varying)::text, ('revoked'::character varying)::text, ('resolved'::character varying)::text])))

constraints.name: evidence_policy_reviews_application_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (application_id) REFERENCES issuance_service.applications(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: evidence_policy_reviews_credential_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (credential_id) REFERENCES issuance_service.issued_credentials(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: evidence_policy_reviews_triggering_fact_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (triggering_fact_id) REFERENCES issuance_service.evidence_facts(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: fk_evidence_policy_reviews_tenant_application
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (organization_id, application_id) REFERENCES issuance_service.applications(organization_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: fk_evidence_policy_reviews_tenant_credential
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (organization_id, credential_id) REFERENCES issuance_service.issued_credentials(organization_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: fk_evidence_policy_reviews_tenant_fact
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (organization_id, application_id, triggering_fact_id) REFERENCES issuance_service.evidence_facts(organization_id, application_id, id)

constraints.name: ck_issuance_transactions_idempotency_pair
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((idempotency_key_hash IS NULL) AND (idempotency_request_hash IS NULL)) OR ((idempotency_key_hash IS NOT NULL) AND (idempotency_request_hash IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: ck_issuance_transactions_issuer_algorithm
constraints.definition: CHECK (((issuer_algorithm IS NULL) OR ((issuer_algorithm)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['ES256'::character varying, 'ES384'::character varying, 'RS256'::character varying, 'EdDSA'::character varying])::text[]))))
constraints.alternate_definition: CHECK (((issuer_algorithm IS NULL) OR ((issuer_algorithm)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('ES256'::character varying)::text, ('ES384'::character varying)::text, ('RS256'::character varying)::text, ('EdDSA'::character varying)::text]))))

constraints.name: ck_oid4vci_ephemeral_capabilities_payload
constraints.definition: CHECK (((((purpose)::text = 'par'::text) AND (payload IS NOT NULL)) OR (((purpose)::text = 'proof_nonce'::text) AND (payload IS NULL))))
